opinions.text: The game's art style and music are very good and most of the fights are fairly challenging or at least visually interesting, however there are several cases where an attack will deal damage to you even when you have an invincibility frame or have a shield that the game says will block all damage.

opinions.text: 《东方冰之勇者记》这部横版弹幕动作射击游戏，美术风格多样化，绘画制作很精致，背景音乐极动听，剧情故事戏剧化，玩家操作要技巧，战斗难度相当高，游戏价格很实在，在一众车万同人游戏，绝对是一款好玩不贵的佳作。
